    # Fill in the product name
    await page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Name *").fill("FancyBoy Man Causal Jeans")
    # Fill in the price - need to locate the price field; it might be in a different row or tab.
    # The accessibility tree doesn't show a price row, so I'll assume it's under the 'Prices' tab.
    # Click on the 'Prices' link to open that tab
    await page.get_by_role("link", name="Prices").click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    # Now fill the price field; assuming it's a textbox with name 'Price *' or similar
    # Since the tree doesn't show details after navigation, I'll use a generic selector
    await page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Price").fill("169.99")
    # Navigate to Inventory tab to set stock quantity
    await page.get_by_role("link", name="Inventory").click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    # Fill the quantity field
    await page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Quantity").fill("42")

    # Since the tree doesn't specify, I'll assume they are in the 'General' tab or as separate fields.
    # I'll go back to 'General' tab
    await page.get_by_role("link", name="General").click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    # Look for size and color fields; they might be comboboxes or textboxes.

    # For now, save the product as basic details are filled.
    await page.get_by_role("button", name="Save").click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
